items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: And when it finally got to the end you looked at the drummer, I guess it was Anton —

ctx.x: Well even though you are piano conducting off Broadway style, piano conductors exist in the off Broadway scene. They don’t have the — again the union. On Broadway you’ve got to have a conductor, who gets double scale or whatever, but off Broadway because budgets are more limited, and that’s, you know even before “The Magic Show” I did one off Broadway show for Joe Papp in 1973. And you’re piano conducting. So if you’ve got one hand free you can conduct with the other hand but sometimes it’s got to be head, and…
I guess. And when it finally got to the end you looked at the drummer, I guess it was Anton —
